qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading Scandinavian non-life insurer (Denmark, Norway, Sweden via Trygg-Hansa) with TryghedsGruppen member bonuses (~5-8%) supporting customer loyalty. Operates with combined ratios in the 80-84% range, though diluted GAAP returns followed the 2021 RSA/Codan mega-acquisition.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Mature Scandinavian non-life insurer constrained by high domestic market saturation and persistent organizational and operational friction from the multi-billion RSA/Codan mega-acquisition. Corporate client churn, multi-year restructuring expenses, and workforce redundancies cap predictable compounding runway to <15 years.
qualitative.evidence: Tryg executed the largest rights issue in Danish history (DKK 37 billion) in 2021 to acquire RSA's Scandinavian operations (Trygg-Hansa, Codan Norway, and 50% Codan Denmark, which was subsequently carved out and sold to Alm. Brand). This massive equity dilution depressed reported GAAP ROE to 5-9% between 2021 and 2023, while per-share EPS compounding stalled (2021 EPS was DKK 8.83 vs 2025 EPS of DKK 8.80). Prolonged restructuring, workforce layoffs, and elevated commercial churn limit predictable secular growth.
